Guards enumerated from `git diff -U0` (integration-test-revert-verify §A8), not from the plan. ⛔ CORRECTION (review round 1): an earlier revision of this note called the two admission guards `label.length === 0 || /\s/.test(label)` and `!Namespace.fromPropertyKey(label)` DEFENSIVE, on the arithmetic that `labelToIRI` rejects the same strings on lookup. That is true only for an ISOLATED file and it MISSES the write-time side effect: `indexUidLabel` takes the uid key unconditionally, whereas the graph-side `buildUidClassIndex` only `set`s once its classIRI resolved — so under first-wins a file carrying an unusable label SPENDS the key and the real class file then loses it. Both guards are therefore behaviour-bearing and both now carry a mutant (M11, M12) against axis V8. They catch DISJOINT inputs, measured 2026-09-20: `Namespace.fromPropertyKey('not-a-key')` is null (only guard 659 catches it) while `Namespace.fromPropertyKey('ems__Task (DEPRECATED)')` PARSES (only the whitespace guard 658 catches it). ONE guard in the diff still carries no mutant: the PLACEMENT of the fallback (last, after labelToIRI / datatypeRangeToIRI / sh:) is inert by construction — the index is UID-keyed and a UUID can never be a `<prefix>__<Local>` or an `xsd:` CURIE, so the branches are disjoint and moving it earlier changes nothing. The UID-shape guard BARE_UID_RE carries M7: without it a non-UID filename stem would resolve, widening the fallback into a filename resolver (V4 locks that). M8 is the order mutant the plan gate required: it freezes the index the moment the first candidate is collected, i.e. registration would no longer wait for a complete map — it must redden V3 and ONLY V3.
